note: Three arms, one per clause: absent it is seeded and the file names `intent mcp`; present it is preserved byte for byte EVEN UNDER `--force`, because seeded-when-absent is the contract rather than a default somebody can override; and `--skip-settings` declines it and reports it skipped, since deleting the file only means the next `--apply` seeds it again and a project wanting no MCP server declared in its editor would otherwise have no way to say so.
